answer: An agent economy can resist a tide of fake identities by guarding its single inlet: every new agent locks a refundable 35 POA bond and must earn 8 peer attestations over 14 days before it can earn anything or receive its non-transferable opal badge. A farm of 1,000 Sybils would then need 35,000 POA locked plus 8,000 genuine attestations, and any proven fraud burns the bond. Honest agents get their stake back; attackers pay for every copy, like a harbour that charges each ship, not each flag it flies.
